Name: Slime Girls
Author: onjulraz
Description:
[center][size=6]Slime Girls[/size]
by onjulraz


[size=5]What is it?
[/size]This is abandoned... for now.  I'm a little busy, but hope to come back to it.

I like slime girls.  You like slime girls.  This had to happen!

Replaces slime enemies with slime girls.


[size=5]Install[/size]
[url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
Requires Content Patcher!

Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
Run the game using SMAPI.

---

To uninstall, remove the folder from /Mods.


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
